0x4986f0.en: You made it! Here is my present for you. Please accept it!

0x498750.en: Then onward, to the Dokapon Kingdom!

0x498780.en: And here we are! This is the Dokapon Kingdom, the world where you will forge a brand-new legend!
0x498780.note: Kingdom arrival; 新たな伝説 = brand-new legend.

0x4987e0.en: The King awaits! Let's go meet him at once!
0x4987e0.note: 王様 = The King (glossary, official). [2026-09-02: rephrased to remove the literal apostrophe per tools/reconcile.py's apostrophe_violation check - no apostrophe glyph exists yet (see skills/PATCH-MOD-ISO.md's 2026-09-02 glyph-feasibility ledger entry). 0x498820.note: King's blunt greeting; 勇者達 = heroes (plural). [2026-09-02: rephrased to remove the literal apostrophe per tools/reconcile.py's apostrophe_violation check - no apostrophe glyph exists yet (see skills/PATCH-MOD-ISO.md's 2026-09-02 glyph-feasibility ledger entry). 0x498840.note: Joint minister line. [2026-09-02: rephrased to remove the literal apostrophe per tools/reconcile.py's apostrophe_violation check - no apostrophe glyph exists yet (see skills/PATCH-MOD-ISO.md's 2026-09-02 glyph-feasibility ledger entry). Old EN: "We've been expecting you."]

0x498860.en: The legendary heroes... they truly appeared...
0x498860.note: Wonder at the prophecy coming true.

0x4988a0.note: 感动ですわ; わ feminine keigo dropped in EN.

0x4988c0.en: To journey here from a distant world...
0x4988c0.note: 異世界 = other world; milestone context = the player's world.

0x4988f0.en: I am Rose Minister, Minister of Finance.
0x4988f0.note: 会計大臣 = Minister of Finance/Accounts; surname ミニストル kept as 'Minister'.

0x498920.en: I am Lavender Minister, Minister of Taxation.
0x498920.note: 税理大臣 = Minister of Taxation.

0x498950.en: We are honored to meet you.
0x498950.note: よろしくお願いいたします in audience context.

0x498980.en: I-It is I, the King of the Dokapon Kingdom!
0x498980.note: ワシ/じゃ old-man dialect rendered as blustery self-announcement.

0x4989b0.note: Teasing that they overlooked the king. [2026-09-02: rephrased to remove the literal apostrophe per tools/reconcile.py's apostrophe_violation check - no apostrophe glyph exists yet (see skills/PATCH-MOD-ISO.md's 2026-09-02 glyph-feasibility ledger entry). Old EN: "Oh, Your Majesty. You're here?"]

0x4989e0.en: We hardly noticed you, sire. Your presence and your hairline have grown so thin.
0x4989e0.note: 影も髪もうすい = shadow and hair both thinning; keeps the bald joke.

0x498a30.en: Grr! This is all Makonde's doing! He made off with every last coin of my gold!
0x498a30.note: ごっそり = scooped out wholesale; D&D-flavored indignation. [2026-09-02: rephrased to remove the literal apostrophe per tools/reconcile.py's apostrophe_violation check - no apostrophe glyph exists yet (see skills/PATCH-MOD-ISO.md's 2026-09-02 glyph-feasibility ledger entry). Old EN: "Grr! This is all Makonde's doing! He made off with every last coin of my gold!"]

0x498aa0.en: Those are the King of the Dokapon Kingdom and his twin ministers. They may not look it, but that's who they are.
0x498aa0.note: ふた子の大臣 = twin ministers; Navi's aside to the players. [2026-09-02: rephrased to remove the literal apostrophe per tools/reconcile.py's apostrophe_violation check - no apostrophe glyph exists yet (see skills/PATCH-MOD-ISO.md's 2026-09-02 glyph-feasibility ledger entry). Old EN: "Those are the King of the Dokapon Kingdom and his twin ministers. They may not look it, but that's who they are."]

0x498b10.en: See, Your Majesty? The heroes are here, just as we hoped.

0x498b50.en: Let us entrust everything to the heroes.
0x498b50.note: おまかせ = leave it to them.

0x498b80.en: R-Right... There is still hope, after all.
0x498b80.note: King rallies after the ministers' nudge.

0x498bc0.en: Navi has told you, no doubt: this kingdom teeters on the brink of ruin. Once, this was a peaceful land... until the sorcerer Makonde looted every coin from the castle vault!
0x498bc0.note: Backstory beat: kingdom crisis + vault theft. 金庫 = castle vault.

0x498e20.en: The moment the gold vanished, this world went wrong. Business dried up, calamities ran wild across the land... And so!
0x498e20.note: 不景気 = recession; 天変地異 = calamities.

0x498ec0.en: To bring peace to the world once more!

0x498ef0.en: You must return the stolen fortune to the vault!
0x498ef0.note: ばく大な = vast; ministers state the objective.

0x498f20.en: Aah! You took the words right out of my mouth!
0x498f20.note: Comedy beat: king's grand line hijacked.

0x498f40.en: We beg of you, heroes. Crush Makonde's ambitions and win back the gold.
0x498f40.note: お願いです + うちくだき = crush; the core quest pitch. [2026-09-02: rephrased to remove the literal apostrophe per tools/reconcile.py's apostrophe_violation check - no apostrophe glyph exists yet (see skills/PATCH-MOD-ISO.md's 2026-09-02 glyph-feasibility ledger entry). Old EN: "We beg of you, heroes. Crush Makonde's ambitions and win back the gold."]

0x498fa0.en: Otherwise, we won't even draw our salaries.
0x498fa0.note: 给料 gag: the ministers' real motivation. [2026-09-02: rephrased to remove the literal apostrophe per tools/reconcile.py's apostrophe_violation check - no apostrophe glyph exists yet (see skills/PATCH-MOD-ISO.md's 2026-09-02 glyph-feasibility ledger entry). Old EN: "Otherwise, we won't even draw our salaries."]

0x498fd0.en: Now that is a pressing matter.
0x498fd0.note: 切実 = dire/serious; Navi plays along.

0x498ff0.en: First, save the Asia area, home of Dokapon Castle. Its villages now suffer under the curse of the monk Sanzou.
0x498ff0.note: 惨憎法師 = Sanzou (pun on 三蔵法師); boss of the Asia area, next milestone.

0x499080.en: The roads between areas are sealed, so you cannot roam the world freely.

0x4990d0.en: Defeat the boss who rules Asia, and the road to the next area should open. Ask each area's village chief about its boss. They will share all kinds of clues.
0x4990d0.note: Boss > chief > clues loop. [2026-09-02: rephrased to remove the literal apostrophe per tools/reconcile.py's apostrophe_violation check - no apostrophe glyph exists yet (see skills/PATCH-MOD-ISO.md's 2026-09-02 glyph-feasibility ledger entry). Old EN: "Defeat the boss who rules Asia, and the road to the next area should open. Ask each area's village chief about its boss. They will share all kinds of clues."]

0x499190.en: To deposit gold into the World Peace Bank, visit a castle or a church. When your purse is full, please put the gold in the vault.
0x499190.note: 世界平和金庫 = World Peace Bank (glossary, web; JP string now confirmed). 城か教会 = castle or church.

0x499360.note: ドカポンヒーロー = Dokapon Hero, the top-gold title.

0x499390.en: There can be only one true hero in all the world! Don't let the others outdo you. Strive with all your might! And take this: your adventure stipend. Buy gear and supplies with it.
0x499390.note: 仕度金 = adventure stipend/starting funds; the hand-out beat. [2026-09-02: rephrased to remove the literal apostrophe per tools/reconcile.py's apostrophe_violation check - no apostrophe glyph exists yet (see skills/PATCH-MOD-ISO.md's 2026-09-02 glyph-feasibility ledger entry). Old EN: "There can be only one true hero in all the world! Don't let the others outdo you. Strive with all your might! And take this: your adventure stipend. Buy gear and supplies with it."]

0x499430.en: Everyone received a gift from the King!
0x499430.note: JP reads 王様からをもらった (dropped object particle); intent clear.

0x499460.en: I'll help you along the way. Let's all give it our best!
0x499460.note: Navi joins the party. [2026-09-02: rephrased to remove the literal apostrophe per tools/reconcile.py's apostrophe_violation check - no apostrophe glyph exists yet (see skills/PATCH-MOD-ISO.md's 2026-09-02 glyph-feasibility ledger entry). Old EN: "I'll help you along the way. Let's all give it our best!"]

0x4994b0.en: First, let's head to the village and lift the curse on the magic circle!
0x4994b0.note: 魔法陣の呪い = curse on the magic circle; next objective. [2026-09-02: rephrased to remove the literal apostrophe per tools/reconcile.py's apostrophe_violation check - no apostrophe glyph exists yet (see skills/PATCH-MOD-ISO.md's 2026-09-02 glyph-feasibility ledger entry). 0x499500.en: Ah, so you are the legendary hero, yes? We have been waiting! You will save us, yes?
0x499500.note: アル dialect tic rendered as a folksy 'yes?' cadence; full dialect is a localization trade-off, noted for critic review.

0x499560.en: Everyone has high hopes for you, hero! Here's the moment: make a big, flashy debut. Knock 'em dead!
0x499560.note: ババーンとハデにデビュー = grand flashy debut. [2026-09-02: rephrased to remove the literal apostrophe per tools/reconcile.py's apostrophe_violation check - no apostrophe glyph exists yet (see skills/PATCH-MOD-ISO.md's 2026-09-02 glyph-feasibility ledger entry). 0x4995c0.en: The one who rules the Asia area is a wandering monk named Sanzou. When he first arrived, he was a very good monk, yes. He used the power of feng shui to solve the villagers' troubles for free, yes. Worries about the future, worries of love, worries of debt. All kinds, yes.
0x4995c0.note: Foreshadowing: Sanzou's fall. 風水 = feng shui; アルヨ tic kept as 'yes'.
